# 1Mind Labs

> 1Mind Labs is a student-led team focused on agentic AI, machine learning, and full-stack development. This single-page site showcases our hackathon projects and team.

## Site Structure

- [Home](https://1mindlabs.org/): Branding and social links
- [Projects](https://1mindlabs.org/#projects): 10 hackathon projects with details
- [Team](https://1mindlabs.org/#team): 25 team members across various tech domains

## Projects

- [cognito.ai](https://cognito.1mindlabs.org): AI-powered evidence discovery for UFDR forensic reports (Smart India Hackathon, 2025)
- [superbox.ai](https://superbox.1mindlabs.org): Platform for discovering, deploying, and testing MCP servers in isolated sandboxes (Ctrl C+Ctrl V, Glytch, 2025)
- [Hireloom](https://hireloom.1mindlabs.org): Autonomous hiring pipeline powered by coordinated AI agents (Recurzive v2, 2025)
- [Payzee](https://payzee.1mindlabs.org): Multilingual CBDC (e₹) payment processor (Sentinel Hack, Code Breaker Challenge, 2025)
- [Hookit](https://hookit.1mindlabs.org): ETL-first workflow manager for on-prem and cloud data sync (GoFr Hackathon, 2024)
- [Crypta](https://crypta.1mindlabs.org): Automated digital forensics and incident response system (Smart India Hackathon, 2024)
- [Mivro](https://mivro.1mindlabs.org): Barcode-based product health analysis app and extension (DevHack v1, 2024)
- [Stock Dragon](https://stock-dragon.streamlit.app): Trading research platform with strategy backtesting (Hackman v7, 2024)
- [Bot Craft](https://github.com/areebahmeddd/botcraft): Discord bot for networking and productivity among remote workers (BotCraft by ByteXync, 2024)
- [Gods Eye](https://gods-eye.onrender.com): News collection, OCR, and misinformation detection system (Smart India Hackathon, 2023)
